notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Doctors.
description:
Cast Twice Upon a Time by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Riku's first ability triggers - choose not to pay.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Twice Upon a Time.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Twice Upon a Time, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal created in step 5, copying Twice Upon a Time and returning the original Twice Upon a Time to your hand.
Resolve Twice Upon a Time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting
